title: ChatGPT Images Just Got a Major Upgrade 🤯

author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Learn how to use ChatGPT Images 2.5 step by step. In this beginner-friendly tutorial, I’ll show you how to generate AI images from scratch, edit existing images, make precise changes, transform photos, combine multiple reference images, create graphics with text, and more.

We’ll start with the new Images experience in ChatGPT and explore templates and prompts. Then, I’ll show you how to add and remove objects, use comments and markup for precise edits, remove backgrounds, resize images, turn sketches into photorealistic images, preserve people and characters across edits, and create complete promotional graphics with text.

By the end, you’ll know how to use the most important ChatGPT Images features to create and refine images until you get exactly what you want.

Host: Kevin Stratvert
